subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing — post-call recap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing — post-call recap

Hi Amit / Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier today — good sync. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the MAP milestone for the load/performance test so we have clear owners, dates, and dependencies. TL;DR: Finexa provides replay artifact and peak QPS profile; Redwood runs a dry-run then a full traffic replay using dedicated capacity; we evaluate latency/cost SLOs and provide a sizing recommendation for production reservation.

Proposed MAP milestone (high level):
- Milestone name: Load test + dedicated sizing run
- Target close for milestone (go/no-go): 2026-08-28
- Customer responsibilities (Finexa):
  - Deliver traffic replay bundle and manifest (replay_manifest.json)
  - Confirm peak observed QPS (p99) and concurrency targets
  - Provide short-lived test credentials / allowlist IPs for replay window
- Redwood responsibilities:
  - Draft test plan and schedule (Redwood CS + SRE)
  - Provision dedicated capacity for the run; run dry-run and full replay
  - Produce run report (latency percentiles, error rates, token costs) and sizing recommendation
- Dependencies:
  - Replay artifact availability (customer)
  - Network access for replay (allowlist)
  - Agreed 2-hr test window with low production traffic
- Proposed dates (customer to confirm):
  - Dry-run: 2026-08-15 — quick smoke to validate replay artifact
  - Full replay: 2026-08-18 (2hr window) — target for sizing output by 2026-08-21

Questions / asks for you right now:
1) Can you confirm the replay artifact will be uploaded by EOD 2026-08-06?
2) What is your expected peak QPS and average request size? (you mentioned ~550 QPS earlier; confirm p95/p99 targets)
3) Any blackout windows we should avoid (timezone aware)?

Attachments: please upload the replay_manifest.json to the shared Drive link I sent during the call (or reply with the file).

If this looks right I’ll convert to a MAP milestone in HubSpot and get Marissa/Neha to propose exact capacity options.

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Finexa is aligned with the milestone and timeline, with a couple of clarifications below.

1) Replay artifact: we’ll upload the replay bundle (replay_manifest.json + payload samples) to the Drive link by EOD 2026-08-06. I attached the manifest here for quick visibility.
2) Peak profile: our observed peak QPS during last season was 600 QPS sustained over ~10 minutes, with p99 latency target of < 350ms. Average request size (tokens): ~210 tokens.
3) Preferred test windows: we prefer early-morning UTC (01:00–04:00 UTC) on 2026-08-18 to minimize production impact. Dry-run on 2026-08-15 between 02:00–03:00 UTC would work.

We’ll also create a temporary service account and a CIDR allowlist for the two test windows; security will share details by 2026-08-06.

Thanks — Amit

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing — Finexa replay details (FYI + action)

Karthik / Neha — reviewed the manifest and customer profile. Quick assessment and proposal below.

Observations:
- Peak 600 QPS with avg 210 tokens implies sustained token throughput ~126k tokens/sec during peak bursts.
- Model family they plan to run is an Llama-variant 13B (from call), which is memory + compute sensitive.

Proposed capacity options (2hr full replay):
1) Conservative (latency-focused): 4 x H100 equivalent, continuous routing on dedicated pool. Estimated pricing delta: higher but lower tail latency.
2) Cost-optimized: 8 x A100 80GB with aggressive batching and KV cache warmup; slightly higher p99 risk but cost reduced ~18%.

Recommended plan:
- Dry-run (2026-08-15 02:00–03:00 UTC): run on cost-optimized config to validate artifact and scripts. Confirm logs and KV cache behavior.
- Full replay (2026-08-18 01:00–03:00 UTC): run conservative config to ensure stable p99 and to produce sizing recommendation.

Operational asks from customer (please confirm):
- Provide exact model variant + weights path (or confirm hosted model name).
- Share allowlist IPs and the temporary service account by EOD 2026-08-06.
- Confirm any pre-warm traffic or token prefixes to include.

I’ll attach a short test plan for their review (load_test_plan_v1.pdf). If Finexa confirms the windows they proposed, we can lock the reservation and I’ll request capacity from infra.

Marissa
Sr. SRE — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
